data.name: Seagate ST506 5 MB hard disk drive

introduced.event_name: NCC 1981 — Logix networking / Artemis PRO launch

manufacturing_requirements: Exact manufacturer/model, interface, formatted versus raw capacity, power/spin-up, dimensions, required controller/cables, defect handling and incoming burn-in.

Selected ST506: 5.0 MB formatted / 6.38 MB unformatted, MFM 5 Mbit/s, 34-pin control and 20-pin data. Budget +12 V 4.5 A startup and +5 V 1 A maximum; qualify controller, spin-up, airflow, harness and mounting. Seagate preliminary OEM manual, April 1981. No cost or qualification claim.
